title: Calculate Average
description: Write a function that calculates and returns the average (mean) of a list of numbers. The average is the sum of all numbers divided by how many numbers there are.
instructions: Complete the calculate_average function so it returns the average of the numbers in the list as a float.
hints: The average is the total sum divided by the count of numbers.
You can find the count of items in a list using len().
Make sure your division returns a float, not an integer.
